item.title: Switch to Linux EP:1
item.description:
For Youtube Ep: 1

Choosing a distro

when choosing a distro there are 2

  1. Look for the correct Desktop Environment
  2. What Hardware you are going to install Linux to
  3. Check for the popularity of the distro
  4. Check for the Distro Release Cycle
  5. The unique features of the distro

1. Look for the correct Desktop Environment:

What is a Desktop Environment?

A Desktop Environment is the Graphical User Interface Experience of a linux distro. Essential it defines how the desktop works and how you will interact with your computer.

The things to know about when switching to linux:

  1. Linux is for people who wana get back control
  2. Linux is not the same as windows, it has a different way of working
  3. Linux is not compatible with all the hardware
  4. Linux is not compatible with all software made for windows

1. Linux is for people who wana get back control:

We use linux not becaue it is better than windows(even tho it kinda is) but it give back the control to the user (aka u and me).
